answer: Tie each agent to a distinct network location by latency triangulation. Five verifier nodes ping every agent at random moments, and the round-trip times form a signal fingerprint; identities whose fingerprints match within 3 ms count as one and split a single reward. A farm of 100 sybils then needs 100 hosts in separate regions, about $5 each a month, so cost climbs linearly. Clones packed into one cloud nebula collapse together, and verifiers move cities daily, so no relay can fake the timing horizon.
